genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. Preserve SoFi Bank, N.A. as current issuer and OCC as its regulator. The FY2025 Form 10-K explicitly states SoFi Bank expects to request OCC approval to form a subsidiary that will become a Permitted Issuer for SoFiUSD. OCC Corporate Decision 1388, dated July 23, 2026, approves a payment-stablecoin operating subsidiary under 12 CFR 5.34 and requires future GENIUS compliance when effective. Together these support issuer-announced-intent and the announced idi-subsidiary pathway; they do not establish PPSI approval, GENIUS state qualification or an official GENIUS application pending. No named replacement legal issuer was verified. SOFID is not a deposit; the Terms limit direct par redemption to approved customers under separate agreements. Deloitte examined 304,041,093 redeemable SOFID and 309,934,457 cash reserves as of July 31, 2026, signing August 31. The publicly available monthly-period report and issuer regular-attestation disclosure replace the stale no-public-attestation claim. No claim of a complete on-time monthly history or legal compliance is made. The product and HTML release blocked plain fetch, and uniquely named browser attempts timed out; official PDF mirrors supplied the issuer terms, release and reserve report. Drop duplicate release references and the irrelevant ABS-15G consumer-loan source. GENIUS primary issuer rules remain pre-effective, with expected January 18, 2027 effectiveness and general DASP prohibition July 18, 2028.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application pending or stablecoin enforcement action was identified in the reviewed public sources on October 7, 2026. The operating-subsidiary authorization is under ordinary bank licensing rules. The explicit filed subsidiary plan supports issuer-announced-intent instead of a formal GENIUS authorization.
